text:
maria: heads up — deploybot flagged SBOM issue for rc11: libfastcrypto@2.1.0 has empty license field. canary in eu-west1 paused, change window ends in ~1h. pinging security/legal.

deploybot: [ALERT] SBOM_MISSING_LICENSE libfastcrypto@2.1.0 -> canary paused. scan_id=sbom-3367
```
path: //layers/libfastcrypto
license: \"\"
```

alex: ack. tagging security. what's the risk severity?

jordan: low/medium. transitive native lib. no CVE flagged by vuln scan, but unknown license metadata blocks enterprise compliance checks.

lia-legal: lia-legal: need artifact provenance + license text. without that, enterprise customers will flag the release. can we reach the maintainer or fallback?

samira: QA: functional tests are green on canary. no runtime errors, but license check is gating release pipeline.

kyle: ops: we can carve out eu-west1 and continue rollout elsewhere in ~15m if legal OKs that. propose regional carveout to avoid global stall.

emily-pm: customers in EU early-access; they'd prefer we hold if legal can't confirm quickly.

maria: proposal: pin libfastcrypto to 2.0.9 (last known-good with license metadata) in rc manifest and continue rollout; timebox 4h for legal/maintainer response. rollback plan ready.

alex: how to pin — hotfix manifest change? paste command please.

maria: ```
# patch manifest
sed -i 's/libfastcrypto@2.1.0/libfastcrypto@2.0.9/' deployments/rc11/manifest.yaml
git commit -am "pin libfastcrypto 2.0.9 to pass SBOM license gate"
./ci/release trigger-canary --regions=global
```

deploybot: deploybot: can execute patch, but note: change window closes in 1h; need approval from release lead + legal before changing prod manifests.

lia-legal: I can approve a timeboxed pin for 4h if we log the decision and notify customers. need a release-note entry and an audit ticket.

maria: creating audit ticket and adding release-note stub now.

maria: audit: https://issues.redwood.ai/RED-1138 (created)

samira: QA will run focused regression suite on pinned build in canary for 30m.

kyle: ops: preparing rollback command in case pin causes regressions:
```
./ops/rollback --to-version=rc10 --region=eu-west1 --reason=\"SBOM license missing\"
```

alex: ok let's timebox. decision: pin to 2.0.9 and continue global rollout except EU unless product wants hold.

emily-pm: hold EU until legal confirms. proceed global except eu-west1.

lia-legal: approved: temporary pin for 4h. log entry = RED-1138. I'll attach approval note to the ticket.

maria: :thumbsup: executing patch now. will update thread when canary resumes.

deploybot: deploybot: patch applied, canary resumed in us-west1/us-east1. eu-west1 remains paused. logs: deployment succeeded for pinned artifact.

maria: release notes draft: \"Temporary pin of libfastcrypto to 2.0.9 due to missing license metadata in 2.1.0. Will re-evaluate when maintainer supplies license text and provenance.\"

lia-legal: add CCM label and compliance_flagged tag on the ticket.

samira: tests passing after pin. monitoring for 30m.

alex: thanks all — keep updates here. if legal confirms license for 2.1.0 we'll unpin and run a rolling upgrade with customers notified.
